segments.en: Soon after entering the Asia Continent, the Iron Gear ran into a brutal ambush.
It somehow broke through the enemy's trap and met up with reinforcements from GEAR.
So this is the machine from earlier...
Cool, huh? It's called Dendoh!
And you are?
I'm Ginga Izumo! I'm Dendoh's pilot!
I'm Hokuto Kusanagi. I pilot Dendoh together with Ginga.
Nice to meet you!
I'm Kanji Akatsuki. We're both pilots, so let's get along!
You bet!
By the way, what about the woman from earlier?
She's the one in charge, isn't she?
Oh, Ms. Vega's on her motorcycle, so she'll probably be a little late.
Ms. Vega's the Vice-Commander of GEAR.
Huh~
Oh! Here she comes!
I've come from GEAR to meet you. My name is Vega.
Without further ado, I'll guide you to GEAR headquarters. Please take me to the bridge.
All right.
Dendoh has been deployed.
The Dendoh Team and Vega have joined the unit.
Well then, I'd better get on with my own job.

rows.notes: Seg 1: [jp] here = GEAR (the organization). Seg 7: speaker header blank, continues Hokuto's self-introduction. | [accuracy 12] project decision: the boys' [jp] = "Ms. Vega" | [accuracy 13] project decision: the boys' [jp] = "Ms. Vega" | [editorial 16] 'to receive you' stiff/ambiguous for [jp]; natural phrasing, Vega's polite register kept | [proofread 13] style sheet: [jp] 'Vice-Commander' (title capitalised)

segments.en: Welcome to Hoshimi!
I'm Elise Willamette, chief of information. I'll guide you into port now!
Gotcha! We're countin' on ya!
Hey... isn't that chief... awfully young?
Oh, you mean Elise.
She's our classmate.
Classmate? So she's in elementary school?
Yeah, Elise is great with computers.
She's smart and all, I guess, but she's such a nag!
I can hear you, Ginga!!
Yikes!
You'll pay for this later!
Elise!
Ah, yes! I'm sorry!
Starting the docking program!

rows.notes: Seg 1: [jp] rendered 'chief of information'. Seg 2: Blume answering the docking guidance ('we're counting on you').

segments.en: Huh~ That Elise girl really knows her stuff.
Hmhm... And you're quite something yourselves, to be able to see that.
By the way, what should we do after this?
Please come to GEAR command by evening. These two will show you the way.
Hokuto, Ginga, I'm counting on you to show everyone around.
Leave it to us!
I'll go on ahead and wait for you there.
Until then!!
Oh... The way she moves... I'd say she's a formidable fighter.
You mean that Vega lady? Yeah, I think so too.
Yeah! Ms. Vega's crazy strong!
...Wait, y-you guys are...!
From the Continental Fighting Tournament...! The Shuffle Alliance!!
Ginga, what are you getting so worked up about?
You! You don't know?!
The five fighters at the very top of the Continental Fighting Tournament!! The Shuffle Alliance!
George de Sand of Neo France,
and Sai Saici of Neo China!
They're both super strong!
Oh right, you do martial arts, Ginga.
That's got nothing to do with it! It's common knowledge! Jeez!
Somehow... hearing that from you, Ginga, is kind of a shock.
Never mind that -- how about showing us around?
Indeed... We still have time before evening.
I would very much like you to show us around the city.
There're plenty of guys on this ship who've never been to the Asia Continent before.
We're counting on you.
Sure! We'd be glad to!
All right! Let's go!
Everyone, we'll show you around. Please follow us.

rows.notes: [jp] = Continental Fighting Tournament (as in dlg_3986_09447_00); [jp] = Shuffle Alliance (standard G Gundam English, not in glossary). Seg 21: Hokuto is shocked to be lectured on 'common knowledge' by Ginga. | [accuracy 1] direction restored: Vega compliments the listeners ([jp]), not 'anyone' | [accuracy 10] project decision: the boys' [jp] = "Ms. Vega"

segments.en: Wow~ What a pretty town!
It's hard to believe this place is at war with Grados.
Really. It's been ages since I've seen a town like this...
Every town on the Gaia Continent was so run-down.
Protecting the peace here is our job!
No way we're gonna let anybody wreck it that easily!
But... the area we can protect right now is pretty limited. The other towns...
That's why we're getting allies together like this, right?
Yeah, that's right...
It's about time. Could you take us to the command center?
Oh, sorry! This way, everyone.
Here we are!
Is this really the place?
Hey... Is this, by any chance... an amusement park?
Surprised? GEAR's command center is under this amusement park!
Ginga! You're too loud!
Whoops! Right...
The base is a secret even from the people in town. Please be careful too, everyone.
Understood.
I'll show you the secret entrance. Please follow me.
Everyone on the GEAR staff is grateful for your cooperation.
I'm Shibuya, the commander. We will give the Iron Gear our full support!
Let us fight together to defeat the Grados Army, which is disrupting the peace of Terra.
Now, let's skip the formalities. First, let me tell you about our organization, GEAR.
So what you're saying is, Asia already had a military force able to stand up to Grados...
Well, as it turned out, yes...
But GEAR's original purpose was to make every preparation against invaders from another world.
The Grados attack was something we never saw coming.
What, you mean there's somebody else comin' after us besides Grados?
Exactly. What we were preparing to fight wasn't Grados, but Galfa.
GEAR is a defense organization built to counter Galfa, and Dendoh is our trump card against them.
Galfa? Never heard of 'em...
Galfa is a mighty mechanical empire...
They're plotting to wipe out every last human being in the world.
Many planets have already been destroyed by them.
I drifted ashore on this continent more than ten years ago.
Ever since then, protecting Terra from Galfa's invasion has been my mission.
According to a recent report, it seems Grados and Galfa have formed an alliance.
If so, the battles ahead will only get tougher.
Gimme a break...
I can't believe it. Galfa, who seek to wipe out humanity, allying with Grados...
Well, quite. We'll keep investigating Galfa,
but for now, let's think about how to deal with the enemy in front of us.
As you all know, the Grados Army is a powerful enemy.
The only reason we've held off the Grados invasion is that we've stuck strictly to defense.
Grados keeps bringing in reinforcements through the Cusco gate and building up its strength.
Our forces have been built up too... but in the end, they're just unmanned weapons.
What we critically lack is capable people.
The truth is, even combining GEAR's forces with the Resistance's, we can't bring the enemy to its knees.
If this goes on, sooner or later we'll be swallowed up by the Grados forces.
That's why we want you to cross the continents and gather people who understand our cause.
All right.
Eventually, we'll have you head to the Pentagona Continent, but the arrangements aren't in place yet.
For a while, we'd like you to operate with this place as your base.
For now, I want you all to get plenty of rest.
In the meantime, we'll draw up an operation plan that includes your forces.
Besides, we need some time to understand one another.
After all, we only know you from data.
That's true... If we push too hard and fail, there'll be no undoing it.
That's the kind of fighting force we are.
Captain Elchi! Let's take them up on their offer and get some real rest.
I suppose so.
Then that concludes today's meeting. Dismissed!

rows.notes: [jp] in quotes rendered GEAR without quotes (same organization as [jp]). Seg 36: [jp] = the Cusco Gate (Cusco Continent). Seg 41: [jp] = people who understand/support GEAR's cause. | [accuracy 12] [jp] = actively disturbing (Grados is already invading), not merely 'threatens' | [editorial 18] 'What's that supposed to mean?' read as hostile; [jp] is a startled 'you mean...?'; Blume's dropped-g voice as elsewhere in the unit | [editorial 37] 'strength... they're' mismatch; 'they' now refers to forces | [editorial 45] 'For now, first of all' redundant ([jp]) | [proofread 36] style sheet: 'gate' lowercase (common noun, cf. 'Austral's gate')

segments.en: There's still time before the next operation.
I should take care of whatever I can while I've got the chance.

rows.notes: Kanji alone: [jp] rendered as his own resolve ('I should').

segments.en: Hey! Kanji! I figure you know already, but we can't ship out.
The Iron Gear's under maintenance, as usual.
Maintenance again... This ship sure is a handful. Want me to help with anything?
We're fine. We've got enough hands, and this time we wanna do it right with just the veterans.
We've been given plenty of time, so I'm thinking of using this chance to overhaul the whole ship.
If it goes well, she might even get a performance boost!
Though we won't know until we try...
Huh~ Now that I'm looking forward to. I'm counting on you!
Leave it to us!

rows.notes: [jp] not quoted as a menu term here, so 'ship out'. | [editorial 5] 'power up her performance' awkward

segments.en: Oh! Kanji! Hello!
Hey! Hokuto!
Huh? You're not with Ginga?
Oh, Ginga's over at my house right now. We're having a dinner party at my place today.
We were short a few things, so I came out to buy them.
Hmm, I see. Sounds like fun.
Oh! I know! You should come too, Kanji.
My mom made way too much, and there aren't enough people to eat it all.
I'd love to, but it'd be rude to just barge in on you.
Not at all! Please don't be shy, just come.
Yeah? Then I'll take you up on that.
Hokuto's House
Hey! You're late, Hokuto!
Sorry, I had a hard time finding it.
Oh, right. I brought Kanji along.
Whoa! Awesome! Now I can ask all about the Cloud Saber!
You're interested in my machine?
Super interested! I mean, it's so cool!
Well, the Iron Gear's got lots of other cool ones too!
Be careful, Ginga. We're keeping all this secret even from Hokuto's parents, you know.
I know, I know!
Um, Kanji...
The fact that we're GEAR staff... it's a secret from our families.
So that's how it is. Please keep it to yourself.
Hold on. Something that big... why keep it a secret from your families?!
A hero's true identity is always a secret! Obviously!
Huh?
Aw, don't sweat the details! C'mon, let's hurry up and go in.
Right. Kanji, come on in.
Uh, y-yeah...
I'm home!
Welcome back. Hm? Another new guest?
Yeah! I ran into him in town.
This is Kanji... He's a pilot.
A pilot?
I'm Kanji Akatsuki.
Ah, if I remember right, you're one of the Iron Gear's pilots!
Huh? Uh... yes, that's right.
You know who I am?
Oh, r-right!! My dad works in the news.
Ah, I see. So that's how...
Keisuke! Don't. Kanji's here on his own time.
Oh, you're right. Sorry, Kanji.
No, it's fine. If anything, I'm the one who dropped in on you out of nowhere.
Ha ha! Don't mention it.
You must be tired. Make yourself at home tonight.
Let's eat already! I've been waiting forever, and I'm starving!
Hehe. All right, all right.
Ahh~ Thanks for the meal!
You're welcome. Was it to your liking?
Yes, very. It was delicious.
Right? Hokuto's mom's stew is the best!
Yeah!
Hehe... I'm glad.
Well, I should be going.
Why not stay a little longer? The kids seem to want to hear more of your stories, Kanji.
Yeah! I want to hear more about the battles on the Gaia Continent.
I've got patrol duty, so I need to head back now.
Just a little bit more! Last thing -- I wanna hear about that Le Caine guy!
Yeah, yeah.
Jeez, what do I do...
Ginga! Hokuto! Knock it off already -- you're putting Kanji on the spot.
Even Mr. Kusanagi is holding back, and he's dying to ask!
Ha ha... If I told my news desk about this, there'd be a real commotion.
Keisuke!
Just kidding, Kanji. At home I leave work at the door too, so come again.
Please do come again.
I will! Thank you very much. Well, see you!
(So that's Hokuto's home. What a close family...)
(At their age, Hokuto and Ginga have been made to carry this city's fate on their shoulders.)
(And yet they have to keep it a secret... That's gotta be rough...)

rows.notes: Seg 19: [jp] = Hokuto's parents (scene is at Hokuto's house); rendered 'Hokuto's parents'. Seg 62: Elise's [jp] = Hokuto's father, rendered 'Mr. Kusanagi'. Seg 63: [jp] = his news desk/editor. | [accuracy 36] [jp] = one of its pilots; 'the pilot' implied he is the only one | [accuracy 69] [jp] is passive: the burden is imposed on them, which the next page builds on

segments.en: Phew... It's pretty quiet out this far.
Hm? What's that noise?
Whoa!! What the--?!
A-A baby?!
Whoops!!
Ow, ow, ow...
What was that light just now...?
Bwaaah!
Never mind that. Where did this kid fall from...?
Fwaaaah, fwaaah
What do I do? I'm in a real fix here...
Ohhh, what do I do...
Huh...! There were other people here, too!
Hey! You there! Are you all right?!
Ugh... uhh... What... what just happened?
Oh...! Mirai? Where's Mirai?
Mirai?
Oh, do you mean this little one?
A minute ago... um... the baby came falling down from above.
Bwaaaah!
Yep, looks like the baby isn't hurt...
Oh... thank goodness, Mirai.
Um... Thank you so much! Er...
I'm Kanji Akatsuki. Just call me Kanji.
Oh, okay. Thank you, Kanji!
Oh, that's right! Auntie! Auntie, come on!
Ow, ow, ow... Natsumi... where the heck are we?
This sure isn't Yumegaoka, that much I can tell...
I don't know either!
But how can you tell it's not Yumegaoka?
Well, look. You can see the ocean, can't you?
Oh! You're right!
Um... Kanji? Is this place... the future?
W-Well, no...
As if! Get a grip, Natsumi!
But...!
Anyway, this is a city called Hoshimi.
So I'm guessing, um... it isn't this "Yumegaoka" place of yours.
Boy, you're not very sure of yourself...
I only just got to this city myself.
Nuohhh... hmmm... Good heavens, what has happened!
Oh! Mr. Eji! Are you okay?
Something dreadful has come to pass...!!
If my hunch is right, this is not the world we lived in. Nor, for that matter, have we come to the future.
That makes no sense! We understand the language, so obviously this is Japan!
Let's go, Natsumi! We'll head into town and find out what's going on.
Oh, okay...
Hold on a sec.
I don't think this old guy's wrong when he says you came from another world.
Huh?
Gahh! I can't deal with this!
Hey, young man!
Hm? What is it, mister?
I am the genius scientist Eji!
Kanji, was it! You show real promise, boy!
I can have a far more sensible conversation with you than with these girls, I'd say!
Won't you tell me what this phenomenon is all about?
Yeah, sure.
But before that, could you tell me about yourselves?
I think that'll make it easier for me to explain.
What a bother, but it does stand to reason.
Hey! You, tell him, why don't you?
Huh...? Me?
That's right! Hurry up and tell him everything!
B-But...
Don't you fret. This young fellow will believe your story, too, I'd wager.
You think so...?
(Listen to the story of Natsumi's world?)

Listen to Natsumi's story
Don't listen (I can guess)
I don't mind if it takes a while.
Besides... I'll believe every word you say, Natsumi. I promise.
Bwaaaah
Mirai...
You're right... This is no time to be hesitating, huh?
All riiight! In that case, I'll tell you the whole thing, start to finish!
All right! Bring it on!
I'm Natsumi Mizuki, a fourth-grader!
One stormy night, a baby suddenly appeared.
And guess what -- it was my baby, Mirai, who'd slipped back in time from 15 years in the future!
Mom and Dad went off to London, so they're away,
and Auntie Izumi, who's freeloading at our place, totally hates babies!
Doing it all on my own is so hard!
But I've made up my mind!
Until the day Mirai can go back to the future safely, I'm the one who'll raise this baby!
'Cause I'm Mirai's mommy!
A few days earlier, Yumegaoka
Natsumi's House
Bwaah! Bwaaaah!
H-Hey, you! Shoo, go away! I'm busy here!
Kyaha, kyahaha! Fyuuu~! Kyaha!
Hey! What're you doing?!
Fwaaaaah!
Aaaah!! My manuscript!!
Bwaaaah!
Gyaaaaaah!! Stoooop!!
Give it here! That's an important manuscript! I said give it here!!
Phew... I almost lost every last page...
Hic... hic...
Bwaaaaah! Bwaaaaaaah!!
Argh! For crying out loud! I'm the one who wants to cry here!!
Natsumiii!! Do something about this!!
Coming! Coming~!
Oh, Mirai! What's wrong? There, there, it's all okay now.
Uuuuu...
Auntie!! You were being mean to Mirai again, weren't you!
I'm the one who got picked on! Look at this manuscript!
Ugh... Whoa...
I'd finished inking it and everything! And then... that Mirai...!
Mirai's a baby, so it can't be helped!
That's why I keep telling you not to let the kid into this room!!
Well, I've got school, you know!
You've got to look after Mirai during the day, Auntie Izumi!
What are you talking about! That's your kid! You're the mother, aren't you?!
Ugh...
This is an important time for me right now! Drawing this manuscript is all I can handle!
Haaah... I'm beat. Something to drink, something to drink...
Hey... Auntie. This new manga of yours... You're going for the newcomer award, right?
That's right!
That's why this is an important time for me!
My future's riding on this award!
But it's another one of your usual violent stories?
And what's wrong with violent stories, huh!
Anyway, what else am I supposed to draw!
Why not try something else? Like shojo manga?
Nah, no way. That kind of stuff just isn't for me!
I'm not so sure...
Anyway, from now on I'm working full-throttle 24 hours a day, so YOU look after Mirai!
Geez! Fine, I get it!
Haaah... Guess I'll have to skip school today...
Fwaah! Bwaaah!
It's been a long time now since Mirai came here, huh...
Natsumiii!! I'm starviiing! Bring me something!
Okay, okay!
Honestly, geez! She's such a slave driver.
Oh! That's right. I'll take some food to Mr. Eji, too.
The other person freeloading at our house is Mr. Eji, a self-proclaimed genius scientist.
But... in the middle of his research, Mr. Eji's lab blew up...
So now he's building us a time machine in our garage.
Once the time machine's done, Mirai can go back to the future.
It's a lot to deal with, but I've got to hang in there!
Um, Mr. Eji?
Hyaaaaaaah!!
What the heck is it nooow!!
Natsumiii! What are you doing?! Shut that thing up already!
Uh-oh...!
Mr. Ejiii!! Mr. Ejiii!!
Oh? What is it?
Um, I'm really happy you're building a time machine for us, but...
could you maybe keep it down a little?
Wha-a-at are you on about!
You're the one who told me to hurry up and build it, so I've been slaving away without a wink of sleep!
Bwaaa
H-Hey! Stop clinging to me!
Oh, Mirai, you mustn't bother him while he's working. It's dangerous, okay?
Phew... honestly, what a selfish girl!
Ahahaha! S-Sorry.
Um... I made a meal for you, Mr. Eji,
so how about calling it a day and trying again tomorrow... or something... haha...
Hmm? Grub?
Let's see... I suppose I'll have some for now.
Hey! Natsumi! Don't spoil him!
What's this? What a racket!
You're the one making a racket!!
Ah! Hey! What do you think you're doing?!
Can't you see? I'm eating.
Geez! Don't go eating other people's food without asking!
Human progress demands sacrifice! Put up with it!
Don't give me that selfish garbage!
You just don't get it, girl! You're about to witness the greatest invention of the century!
I'll pass on that, thanks! I can't have our food sacrificed for it!
Get your own food yourself! Got that!
Auntie! If Mr. Eji doesn't build the time machine, Mirai can't go back to the future!
Like he can be trusted! And I can't believe we've got a shady old geezer like this freeloading here!
You're freeloading too, Auntie!
Listen, you! I earn my own pocket money doing assistant work, fair and square.
Anyway, do you really think some scientist nobody's ever heard of can build a time machine?
What?! You'd mock my research?!
Yeah! I would!
Honestly, you're just...!
I wish Auntie Izumi would be a little more patient, too...
Fwaaaah!
If you're a genius scientist, then show me some proof!
Oho, if you insist, then I'll show you!
It's not finished yet, but it can at least warp space-time!
Huh? Nobody's asking you to warp anything!
Now then, here goes!
Hey! Listen when people talk to you!!
Gahh! So loud! You'll disturb the whole neighborhood!!
Mr. Eji, stop it!
Hahaha! Rest easy!
Space-time around this house has begun to distort! This noise won't even reach next door!
Waaah! I don't get it, Mr. Ejiii!
Never mind that! Turn it offff!
H-Hey!! Don't touch thaaat!!
If you don't want me touching it, then YOU turn it off!!
Nwahhh! What kind of girl are you!!
Yeah, THIS kind of girl! Take that! And that!
Nwahh!! I told you to stooop!
Kyaaaaah!!
Whoa! Wh-What now!
Don't tell me it's gonna explode!!
Nuuu... this is...!!
What is it already!
Terrible! Something terrible has begun to happen in this house!
What on earth happened?
Uohh...! Ter-ri-ble!!
Just groaning about it doesn't tell us anything!
Terrible! If my guess is correct, then it's...!
Something incredibly, horribly terrible!!
Kyaaaaah!
Hyaaaah!!
Bwaaa
...And that's what happened. Next thing we knew, we were here...
The time machine wasn't finished yet.
So I can't say whether we traveled through time as well.
...And that's what happened. Next thing we knew, we were here...
I'm pretty sure of it... You've come here from another world.
What does that mean?
Yeah. How can you tell something like that?
Because I'm in pretty much the same boat.
Huh? Then you too, Kanji?
Yeah... that's right. I came from a different world than this one, too.
Listen. In this world, it's not that rare for people to come over from other worlds.
This is a world called "Terra," but I'm not originally from here either.
Recently, some guys showed up who can open gates to other worlds at will...
They're dragging the surrounding worlds in and trying to spread war everywhere.
I chased them all the way here.
Hmm... It's interesting, but it sounds kinda fishy...
Maybe so. But this world may look peaceful at first glance, and yet a war has broken out here.
Anyway, right now you need a place where you can live safely, right? For Mirai's sake, too.
I don't know what the world you came from is like, but I think I can probably help.
As long as I can continue my research, I'm content. Young man! Take me to your home!
Understood. I'll take you to the ship.
No use thinking about it, I guess... Oh well, whatever happens, happens.
Let's go, Natsumi! Don't you dare let go of Mirai!
Okay!

rows.notes: [jp]/[jp] -> 'Mirai'/'Natsumi' (-chan dropped); [jp] -> 'Mr. Eji'; [jp] -> 'Auntie'. Mirai's gender is not in the glossary, so Mirai is never 'he/she' (seg 84 'raise this baby'). Seg 38: Kanji's katakana [jp] rendered as quoted '"Yumegaoka" place of yours' to keep the unfamiliar-name feel. Seg 69: choice menu, two options split by a line break. ([jp] echoes [jp]); 'What a girl!!' lost the joke | [proofread 166] punctuation: direct question (Eji answers it) ended with '!'; '?!' as in 4015_09503_00 16.49

segments.en: So this is your ship?
Yes. You'll be safe here for now.
Huh~
Mirai! It's a great big ship, huh?
Bwaaah!!
Wait here for a little while.
I'll go talk to HQ and make sure this city takes proper care of you.
Hmm... I see. I think I've got the gist of it.
So... you want GEAR to take in this family from Yumegaoka, is that it?
Right now they're under temporary protection on the Iron Gear, but it's a warship, after all...
What do you think, Vega?
I'm in favor as well.
There's no better place to shelter civilians from another world than GEAR headquarters.
Then it's decided. We'll take in the refugees from the other world here. Vega, would you go and pick them up?
Understood.
Kanji, it'd be best if you went along, too. Head back to your ship.
Roger!

rows.notes: Seg 8: [jp] -- 'go along with them' (accompany Vega to fetch the family); object not stated. | [editorial 0] 'I've grasped the general situation' stiff for mild-mannered Shibuya | [editorial 8] 'go along with them' -- only Vega is going; 'them' misdirects (object unstated in JP, per translator note)

segments.en: Wait a moment, Kanji.
What is it, Ms. Vega?
Natsumi and the others appeared along with a flash of light... That's what you said, right?
Yes... I think it was probably some kind of gate connecting to another world.
You sound confident...
Well, I've crossed through gates plenty of times.
I see... So you're speaking from experience.
It's precisely because I've crossed through a gate myself that I can understand what you're saying, Kanji...
But... ordinary people would find it hard to believe, wouldn't they?
Right. That's why I thought it'd be best to have GEAR protect them.
I suppose so...
But why did they show up in this city...? That bothers me a little...
Hmm... I don't think there's anything suspicious about those folks, though...
Oh, that's not what I mean.
It's just that there's something bothering me personally...
Like a sign that something ominous is about to happen... that sort of feeling, I suppose...
Something ominous...?
Oh, I'm sorry. GEAR will investigate this matter, so don't worry about it.
If you find out anything, let me know!
See you!
Easy for you to say "don't worry about it"...

rows.notes: Seg 11: [jp] / seg 12 [jp] -> 'they' / 'those folks' (group includes Eji). | [accuracy 1] project decision: Kanji's [jp] = 'Ms. Vega' | [editorial 14] 'in my own way' awkward for [jp] | [editorial 15] 'a feeling like it's an omen of something ominous' redundant/clunky; 'ominous' kept for Kanji's echo on the next page

segments.en: Oh... Kanji.
Hey! Natsumi. And sorry to keep the rest of you waiting.
Hey, Kanji...
This ship... looks like it's got cannons on it?
"Looks like," nothing! Those are real cannons!
Means these folks are out there blasting away at somebody!
You've gotta be kidding! Riding around on a warship like this, we could die any minute!
Um... What's going to happen to us now?
For a while, you'll be under the protection of GEAR headquarters.
GEAR headquarters, you say?
It's the biggest base on the Asia Continent. They'll understand your situation, and it's much safer than anywhere else.
Someone from GEAR will be here to pick you up soon.
People from another world... I am Vega, vice-commander of GEAR.
I promise to keep you all safe under our protection.
Wh-What? Who is this...?
Um... does everyone at the base... um... wear a mask?
Hmhm... This one is mine alone. For certain reasons, I can't take it off right now.
Is that so... Ahahaha... (sweat)
This keeps getting shadier and shadier.
Auntie... at this point, all we can do is brace ourselves.
I guess so... Don't you leave my side, Natsumi!
Okay!
What are you lot whispering about?
Nothing, nothing! Hahaha... (sweat)
Masked girl, would you take us to this headquarters of yours, and be quick about it?
Understood. Right this way, please.
Phew... That settles that for now...
Kanji, sorry, but we're heading to GEAR headquarters right away.
Everything's ready already?
Yeah. All that's left is to go over the operation.
Thing is, I was just at the command center a minute ago...
Looks like you were sheltering some civilians...
Yeah. As usual, they wandered in from another world.
Once this fight is over, I'll arrange for them to get back to their own world properly.
So you're saying Claudia can do that?
I've heard it's a sealed technology...
I don't really get how it works, but there've been a few cases before. I think it's probably possible.
Maybe the Redros Army is making use of it.

rows.notes: Seg 17/23: [jp] kept as '(sweat)'. Seg 34: [jp] taken as the world/power Claudia (Kanji's side); Amuro's line is a question. | [editorial 16] Vega's [jp] unified with her earlier 'Hmhm...' (dlg_4014_09502_00 row 2)

segments.en: ...As I've laid out, now that Dendoh has joined the Iron Gear's mobile forces,
it has become possible to devise an operation in which we take the offensive.
That alone should let us catch the enemy off guard.
So? Where's the target?
There's a Grados Army supply depot somewhere on the Asia Continent.
Supplies from the Gaia Continent should be gathered there.
In other words, we find the supply base and smash it, right?
Precisely.
If this operation succeeds, the enemy won't be able to make a move for a while.
We have to make it succeed, no matter what.
You bet! Let's go, everyone!
Right, let's go. The sooner the better, right?
Very well! As of this moment, the operation is underway! All personnel, to your stations!
Roger!!
Roger!!

rows.notes: Seg 4: [jp] = 'supply depot'; seg 6 [jp] = 'supply base'. | [editorial 4] inverted 'Somewhere ... is a ...' reads literary for a spoken briefing

segments.en: All right! We're finally setting out!
You're awfully fired up. Did the ship's maintenance go well?
Yeah! The refit was a success. The engine's running great, too!
And the Iron Gear's base performance should be up, too.
Here! This is the list of upgrades.
The Iron Gear's armor and carrying capacity have been increased.
Whaaat? Are these numbers for real? That's amazing!
Heh... I was given the time to do it.
Wow~ You're pretty skilled.
Tee-hee.
Of course! It's all thanks to my excellent guidance!
Yeah, yeah.
All right! Iron Gear, move ouuut!

<Mission Objective>
Locate the Grados Army base

rows.notes: Seg 13: [jp] -> '<Mission Objective>' (no earlier precedent found). | [accuracy 13] literal backslash-n in draft; real line break restored

segments.en:
Pentagona Continent
Border Watch Fortress "Theart Star"
Amazing facilities... It's like a fortress.
This is Theart Star. It's a special zone granted self-rule by Poseidal, who governs Pentagona.
To get from the Asia Continent to the Pentagona Continent, you have to pass through here, but...
We can't get through just yet...
Can't we at least dock there?
Yeah... We'd like to resupply, but more than that, we might get some useful information.
I know how you feel, but...
Here they come!
This airspace is the territory of Theart Star.
You may not pass through here without permission! Withdraw immediately!
I repeat! Withdraw immediately!
Your vessel's passage permit has not been confirmed!
If you continue to ignore our warnings, we will attack without mercy!!
Change course at once!
Just as I thought... The paperwork to get through here is a real pain.
I guess forcing our way through isn't an option, huh...
No way! Theart Star has the Poseidal Army backing it, you know.
Changing course!

rows.notes: [accuracy 0] literal backslash-n in draft; real line break restored | [editorial 6] 'That's true' does not answer Kanji's question 'Can't we at least dock there?'

segments.en: Docking at Theart Star is currently not permitted.
Changing course inland.

rows.notes: Narration/system message; 'Changing course inland.' kept subjectless as a status message.

segments.en: Dead ahead! I've spotted what looks like an enemy base!
It's camouflaged, but with a heat source that big, there's no mistake.
Their guard is lax. If we strike now, we can take them in one go!
Elchi! Give the order to attack!!
All hands! Battle stations!!
What's that? The enemy?
It's them!! Those Iron Gear bastards are attacking!
Damn that Iron Gear lot, getting full of themselves!
Intercept them at once!!

<Win Condition>
Sink the enemy mothership within the time limit

rows.notes: Seg 4: [jp] -> '<Win Condition>' as in earlier slices. | [accuracy 4] literal backslash-n in draft; real line break restored | [editorial 2] 'that Iron Gear ... themselves' number mismatch

segments.en: They put up less of a fight than I expected.
You think? There were tons of enemies!
True, there were a lot of them. But their formation was far too weak. I can only assume their commander is incompetent...
Anyway, I'll try forcing my way inside.
If it goes well, we might get our hands on some Grados Army documents.
Please do. Once you're inside, send us the data.
The Iron Gear will mop up the remaining enemies!!
We'll avoid firing on our Infantry Squad's entry route and hit the supply base with everything we've got!
Main cannon! Fiiire!!

rows.notes: Seg 7: [jp] -> 'Infantry Squad' (UI term). | [editorial 3] 'breaking into the interior' clunky for [jp]

segments.en:
The systems here are
still up and running.
I sense an immense pressure.

Looks like we'll just have to
force our way through. Let's go!
Heh... Understood!

Grados Army
Supply Base Command Center

This is Gun Emplacement No. 34!
We're under heavy enemy bombardment!
Send reinforcements!!

What the hell is HQ doing?!
They expect us to fight without SPTs?!

The battle does not seem
to be going well.

Areas 5 and 6 have
gone silent as well.

We can't hold out any longer!
Requesting permission for
a full retreat!!

Denied!
Hold your current position
to the death!!

Wha--!
Why?!
Further resistance is pointless!

Did you not hear me?
Hold to the death... I said.

I... I cannot accept
an order like that!

Are you saying that holding this
position to the death has
strategic value?!

Whatever the reason, I will not
tolerate disobedience of my orders!

Why...?! In this battle, our forces
were obviously deployed all wrong!

Ah...! Don't tell me...
you planned this!

To wear down the
strength of Grados...!

This defeat merely proves that
the soldiers of Grados are weak.
What did you say?!

In numbers, the deployment should
always have let you face the enemy
with equal or greater strength.

And yet you were defeated
this easily...

A force like that cannot possibly
be worth anything. I have no need
for weak soldiers!

D-Damn you!!
You Galfa dog!

I'll report this to
His Excellency Gresco!!

Do as you like...
if you can leave this base alive.
What?!

Fuhaha!!
How feeble, human!!

Wh-What?!
Who are you?!
Hrrraaah!!
Gwaaaaah!

So you have come,
warrior of the Yoja.

Arthea, you said a human who'd
give me a real fight was coming.
Is it this one?
Ughhhhh...

Not such small fry as that.
The real prey will arrive shortly.
Bide your time a little.

Be careful! For a while now,
an uncanny killing intent
has been building.
Here it comes!!

rows.notes: seg 9, 14-16, 19, 21-22, 29: blank-header pages continue the Grados Officer. seg 37: [jp] rendered as plain address 'Arthea.' ([jp] lighter than [jp]). | [accuracy 21] [jp] is a gasp of realization; 'Hah' reads as a laugh | [editorial 21] accuracy edit used '/' as a line break; it would display literally | [editorial 37] vocative read as a stray statement; comma, as in the same soldier's 21.3 | [editorial 41] 'ever since a moment ago' awkward

segments.en:
Heh heh heh...
Welcome, elite warriors
of the Iron Gear.

Fuhaha!!
How feeble, human!!

Arthea,
are these the ones?
The humans with some backbone?
Indeed...

Arthea...?
It can't be...
That's impossible......

Well, then!
Let's put you to the test!!

These beings...
They're no ordinary humans.

Oh...
You defeated the Yoja Soldiers?
Now that is unexpected.

To think humans had
fighters this skilled...

You seem to be the
commander of this base.

Surrender!
And order all your forces
to cease fire!

Fuhahahahaha!
Do you think you've won?

Heh... To me, this base is
nothing but a sacrificial pawn.

No...
I should thank you for so
conveniently destroying it.
What do you mean?

There is no need to explain.
History will answer in time.

But your survival was
a miscalculation on my part...

In tribute to your prowess in battle,
I shall tell you something,
as a special favor.

Right about now, GEAR HQ
is under a Yoja assault.
That is my plan.

But...
what in the world are the Yoja...?!

The Yoja are evil beings who
descend from another world...

It seems GEAR, relying on its
science, was unable to
detect their approach.
Arago's Castle

Oh no... While the Iron Gear
and Dendoh are away!

Ms. Vega...
It seems we've been
completely set up.

Yes... But somehow we have to
get back to the Iron Gear
and warn them about this.
Vega... you say?
Nnnnnngh...!!
Now's our chance!!
Hurry, we're going back!!

Grr...!
Damn you!!

I wonder what that was...
The moment he heard Ms. Vega's
name, that guy...

In any case, that saved us.
It looks like we'll be able
to get away.

GEAR HQ is
under attack?

Isn't it defended by
unmanned weapons?

Against the brute force Grados
has used so far, the unmanned
weapons can hold their own.

But against those soldiers we fought,
the ones called Yoja...
Yoja?
What's that?

I don't know...
But ordinary soldiers stand no
chance against that evil power.

Damn!
Natsumi and the others are
at GEAR HQ too!

To think it'd become
the enemy's target!

Light!
Can't even the D-3's sensors
tell what's going on?

No good!
Every sensor we have
is being jammed!

For some reason, we can't get any
read at all on the area around GEAR!

Whatever! We've just gotta
hurry back, right?!

That's right!
Even while we're sitting here,
the enemy is...!

Captain Elchi,
for now, let's just hurry!
Right!

Iron Gear!
Move out for GEAR HQ!!
Ngh...

That ominous feeling I had before
we sortied... Could that have
been the Yoja?

The enemy's target is
probably GEAR HQ...

If I'd known this would happen,
I'd have brought Natsumi
and the others along...!
Head for Hoshimi Town!

rows.notes: seg 0: George's [jp] taken as the Yoja Soldiers just beaten. seg 15: speaker header is Vega but the archaic [jp] reads like George; kept neutral wording that fits either. seg 17: [jp] here = the GEAR organization (relies on science). seg 18: [jp] scene label -> Arago's Castle (UI form). seg 53: [jp] -> Hoshimi Town (not in glossary; Hoshimi from library 'Hoshimi Elementary'). | [accuracy 20] project decision: [jp] = 'Ms. Vega' (George addressing her) | [accuracy 30] project decision: [jp] = 'Ms. Vega' (Sai Saici) | [editorial 20] accuracy edit used '/' as a line break; it would display literally | [editorial 30] accuracy edit used '/' as a line break; it would display literally | [editorial 31] 'we were saved' stiff | [editorial 46] 'let's hurry, no matter what' unidiomatic for tonikaku

segments.en:
Full speed ahead!!
Can't we go any faster?!

Don't be crazy!
The engines'll burn out!

What?!
Weren't they supposed to
have been powered up?!

Elchiii!!
Enemies!
There's a huge enemy force!!
What did you say?!

Heh heh heh...
I won't let you pass!

What the?!
What is that black one?!
A black Dendoh?

Th-That's...!
Knight Ouga!
It can't be!
Why is Ouga here...?!

rows.notes: [jp]/[jp] -> Knight Ouga/Ouga per glossary and term_fixes (Knight Ogre -> Knight Ouga).

segments.en:
Like hell I'm gonna
lose heeeeeere!!

Heh...
So that's the other Gear, Dendoh!
However!!
Waaaaaaaaah!!

It may be the other Gear, but with
pilots like these, it's hardly
worth worrying about...!

I'll be taking that Gear as well.
While it sits over there, it only
makes things complicated!

rows.notes: [jp] here = the machine class (Dendoh as the other Gear besides Ouga), written 'Gear'; the organization [jp] is 'GEAR'. seg 5: the source's doubled [jp] is garbled; rendered the evident sense.

segments.en:
Iron Gear,
full speed ahead!!
Aye aye!

Not bad,
Iron Gear.

You seem blessed with
warriors of real promise.

But...
it wouldn't be any fun otherwise.

Now, how will
Grados respond...?

We're almost there, Ginga!
We should be able to see
the town soon.
What the...?

There's something weird
hanging over the town!
You're right!

Is that what
they call the Yoja?

From here our range should
hold out. Let's go, Kanji!

Right!! Units with enough range,
let's go support GEAR HQ!!
I'm counting on you all!

I am Arago.
I am the lord of the world of darkness.

Now my empire shall
rule over this world!

Know that now begins
our reign over the land!!
Still no contact with Vega?!

Heavy jamming is preventing
any contact!
Enemy airborne troops descending!
They're surrounding GEAR HQ!
What about the defense divisions?!

The 6th Defense Division
has been wiped out!

Our attacks are having
almost no effect!!
We're being cut down one-sidedly!
Kyaaaaaah!!

Impossible!!
Surprise attack or not, you're
telling me we can't hold out?!

Deploy all unmanned units!!
Evacuating residents is top priority!
Buy us every second you can!!
Mmmgh!

The first bulkhead
has been breached!

70% of systems are down.
Protective barrier operating
at 20%.
This is terrible...

All base personnel except main staff,
evacuate HQ immediately!!

All personnel except main staff,
please evacuate!

I repeat!
All personnel except main staff,
please evac--!

Seems there's been quite a racket
going on outside for a while now.

What?
Is it a war?

Anyway, let's get outside!
If we stay in a place like this,
we won't be able to escape!
Huff, huff, huff, huff...

Natsumi!
This way!

rows.notes: seg 6: [jp] = units with long range. seg 17: subject of [jp] unstated; read as the defenders' attacks (follows the wiped-out division). | [editorial 6] accuracy flag: 'long-range units' read as weapon range; this is cruising range (answers Amuro's line) | [editorial 29] tense clash ('seems to be ... for a while now'); Eji's casual old-man voice | [proofread 27] punctuation: mixed '--...' on a cut-off word; single interruption dash

segments.en:
Aaah!
The light's red!!

Auntie!
Are you sure you're okay
to drive?!

Gah!
This is no time to be
obeying traffic rules!

Fuhahahaha!!
And where do you think
you're going?
Eeeeek!!

Wh-What do you want?!
Out of the way!!
Hrrrraaah!!
Kyaa!!

Fuhahahaha!
Diiiie!!
What?

Who's there?!!
Who dared throw a stone
at me?!

Attacking a little girl
isn't something a warrior does!

Hmph!
Then why don't you stop hiding
and come out yourself!

Yeah,
I'll do just that!

I smite evil with a heart of Benevolence!
Ryo of Rekka is here!!

You Yoja scum!
I'm the one you'll be fighting!

Fuhahahahaha!
Insolent humans!

You're perfect for ringing down
the curtain on this rotten world!
Raaaaah!!
Haaaaaaah!!

Fuhahaha!
That tickles!
Ngh...!

Fuhahaha!
This is the end for you!
Gwaaaah!!

Now then, we'll be
taking it from here!

I smite evil with a heart of Wisdom!
Toma of Tenku is here!!

This is way too slow!
I can't stand just watching!

I smite evil with a heart of
Righteousness! Shu of Kongo is here!

You're sure taking
your sweet time.

I smite evil with a heart of Trust!
Shin of Suiko is here!

Looks like we
made it in time.

I smite evil with a heart of Courtesy!
Seiji of Korin is here!

Ooh, oooooh!
Cu-Cursed humans!
You'll pay for this!
Are you all right?

Thank you...
You really saved us.

Heh heh!
Now that we're here,
you've got nothing to worry about!
Just who are you guys?

We're the
Samurai Troopers.

When the Yoja appear in this world,
we strike them down with the power
of our armor! That's our duty.
Samurai... Troopers...

All right, everyone!
Let's go!!
Yeah!!

Now all five
of us are together!

Let's combine the power of all five
and protect the town from the Yoja!
Yeahhh!!
Destroy the Yoja Gate

rows.notes: seg 1: Natsumi calls Izumi [jp] (her aunt) -> Auntie; Izumi is driving. Ronin intros (seg 15/26/28/30/32): fixed pattern 'I smite evil with a heart of <virtue>! <Name> of <Armor> is here!' with library virtue words (Benevolence/Wisdom/Righteousness/Trust/Courtesy) and glossary armor names (Rekka/Tenku/Kongo/Suiko/Korin). seg 25: [jp] -> 'us' (Toma arrives with the others). seg 34: [jp] kept as plain 'you' (Natsumi, Izumi, possibly Eji). | [accuracy 45] [jp] is a rallying cheer answering Ryo, not surprise ('Ohhh') | [editorial 25] 'how about leaving the rest to us!' read as a question with '!'; makaseru as an assertive takeover | [proofread 11] punctuation: question marked with '!!' only; '?!!' keeps the doubled force

segments.en:
Ooh, oooooh!
Cu-Cursed humans!
You'll pay for this!
All right!

Let's drive the Yoja
right out of town!
Right!
Wait!!

A powerful aura is approaching!
This is no ordinary Yoja!

Heh heh heh...
Fuhahahahahahahahaha!!
Who's there?!!

I've had a good look
at your power!

Floundering like that against mere
Yoja Soldiers...! You're no match
for me after all!!
Who are you?!

Heh heh heh...
It's been a while since
I was in the human world.

The Four Masho themselves will
deal with you! Be grateful!

Destroy the "Yoja Ship" or
repel all of the "Four Masho"

rows.notes: [jp] -> Four Masho (library form; UI uses '4 Masho'). | [proofread 1] punctuation: question marked with '!!' only; '?!!' keeps the doubled force (Shuten Doji answers)

segments.en:
Hmmm... So they have appeared...
the Samurai Troopers, with the
power of the armor!

Lord Arago! This is terrible!
The castle is being pushed back
into the Yoja World!

At this rate, the human world
and the Yoja World will be
cut off from each other again!

Hmph!
It is but a barrier made by humans...
It seems it is still incomplete.

No matter...
In time, the veil of darkness
will fill the human world.

When it does, the Yoja Gate
will open of its own accord.
Recall the Four Masho at once!
At once!

rows.notes: seg 5: [jp] -> Yoja Gate (glossary [jp]).

segments.en:
Hm?
The enemy is pulling back...
What's going on?!

Samurai Troopers...! You alone
I cannot leave be.

I shall bury you
with my own power!
Die!!

Fuhahaha!
Samurai Troopers... you shall
never appear again.
What?!

Ah!
Those guys are...!

Those fellows turned into
balls of light.

They flew off
somewhere.

Oh...
The sky is clearing up.

Fuhahaha!!
Wait for me, humans!
I shall surely return!
Fuhahahahahahahahaha!!

Are we...
safe now...?
Looks like it...
Heeey!

Heeey!
Natsumiii!!
Oh, it's Kanji.

Heeey!
Over heeere!!

Thank goodness!
Is everyone all right?

We're
okay...

Some guys in armor
protected us.

But after they protected us,
they turned into light
and flew away.

And then that giant castle,
which must have come from another
dimension, just vanished.

I'm sure those guys drove it
away for us... by sacrificing
themselves... *sob*...

I'm sorry...
It's all because I took
you to HQ...

That's not true.
Maybe being at that base
is what kept us safe.

It's not your fault...
We made it through
safe, after all.
Yeah, that's right.

Still... I've learned rea~lly well
that this is one crazy world.

Be that as it may,
I'm starving.
Shall we get something to eat?

You make it sound so easy!
It's your machine's fault
we ended up here!!

What a persistent girl!
We're here now,
and that's that!

Besides, it's your fault for
fiddling with it the wrong way.

You've got all your limbs,
so be glad of it!!
Wh-Why you~!
Uh, um... (sweat)
Bwaaaaah!

Ahaha!
Mirai, weren't you
scared?
Bwaaah!

Sigh...
I've lost all my motivation...

Our ship's back too, so things
should be safe for a while.

Sorry, but could you
head back to GEAR HQ?

Indeed, there I can
continue my research!
Back we go!
Yeah, yeah...

Um, Kanji...
Thank you.
Well, see you later.

rows.notes: seg 8/22/25: Natsumi's [jp] (the Troopers) -> 'those guys' / 'some guys in armor'. seg 44: Kanji asks Natsumi's group (not himself) to return to HQ.

segments.en:
Good work, members
of the Iron Gear.

Thanks to you, the enemy
base has been destroyed.

That will let us keep the
Grados Army in check for a while.

Never mind that,
is GEAR HQ okay?

Repairs to the command center and
the town are moving at full speed.
Leave that side of things to us.

It seems the enemy that attacked
HQ was "Arago" of the "Yoja World."

But why did the
enemy pull back?

Which means we'll need to
stay fully on guard.

What matters is that the enemy
is tied to this thing called
the "Yoja World."

Grados, Galfa,
and now the Yoja...

If these forces are working together,
we'll have to rethink our
strategy as well.

I think the Redros Army forces
I've been chasing are more than
a little involved in this too.

The key to the series of battles
we've been through lies hidden there.

Well, if we want to find out,
we've got no choice but to keep
moving forward.

Hmm. It seems we'd better move
up our departure for Pentagona.

I'll make sure to get you
permission to pass into Pentagona.

Please wait a little
while longer.
Got it.
Dismissed!

rows.notes: seg 5: the furigana gloss [jp] dropped. [jp] -> Yoja World (term_fixes). | [accuracy 12] [jp] = 'not a little', the draft's 'to some extent' weakened it | [editorial 12] accuracy edit tacked 'and more than a little' on the end (and used '/'); same meaning, natural order

segments.en: All right, let's head out!

Our objective is to survey enemy
strength. If we can beat them one by
one, we can split their forces further.

We can't go to
Pentagona yet anyway.

So let's take out as many enemies
as we can while we've got the chance!

But if we just run around without
a plan, we'll only wear ourselves out.
Urk!

Hahaha!
He got you there, Kaine!

Say, I have a suggestion. Why don't
we go a bit further while we're at it
and visit the enemy supply base?

We might still be able to
get some information there.

True. Thanks to the Yoja getting
in the way, we never finished
investigating the base.

Leaving the town is risky, but if
the enemy base is being rebuilt,
we should hit it once more.

Sounds good to me.
What do you say, Captain Elchi?
Sure!
Then let's get going!
Iron Gear, move out!

"Head for the ruins of the
enemy supply base"

Looks like there are
no enemies here.

It hasn't been repaired at all...
Maybe they've abandoned it.

I'll go take a look
inside right away.
Right, let's go too.

It's huge... And it looks like
they'd stockpiled a whole
lot of weapons.

Were they saving up their strength
for the invasion of Pentagona...?
Or perhaps...

Maybe they never thought
we'd come attack them?

Gradosians seem to really
look down on the people of Terra.

rows.notes: [accuracy 3] project decision: [jp] = Gradosians | [editorial 1] 'Or else...' reads as a threat | [editorial 3] accuracy edit used '/' as a line break; it would display literally

segments.en: This is...
Did you find something?

Oh, yes...
There are some documents here...

Wh-Whoa, this is an
operations plan! To think it
survived without being burned...

Let's see...
Huh, the enemy commander
is... Arthea...

It even lists where he's from.
Let's see... G-Galfa?

Why would a Grados Army
commander be from
the Galfa Empire?

If the Grados Army and Galfa
have formed an alliance,
it's conceivable, but...

Still, a commander who isn't
from Grados certainly bothers me.

Arthea of the Galfa Empire...
He might turn out to be
a real slippery customer.

What's wrong,
Ms. Vega?

Oh, I'm sorry.
I was spacing out a little...

...I'll go check out
the room over there.

The commander... Arthea...
It can't be...

My brother...
a lackey of Galfa...?

No... It's impossible.
My brother can't be alive.

segments.en: Are you done looking around?

Yeah, there were documents left
that tell us about the enemy.
These'll come in handy.

There's no point staying here.
Let's head straight back to HQ.
Return to Hoshimi Town
Here we are.
Good work!
Iron Gear, now docking.

They really are
something, those people......

segments.en:
Gaia Continent
"Grados City"

Today, once again, the sunlight
falls equally upon all things...
Upon Terra, and upon Grados alike...

To think I would lose
the base in Asia......

The conquest of all Terra...
is taking longer than I expected.
Excuse me, sir!!

Your Excellency, the Saint of Cusco
is again requesting an audience
with you this morning.

What shall I do?
Shall I send her away?

No...
I will meet her...
Sir...?
Show her in.
But...!

The human heart is a fickle thing...
I find I wish to meet her.

Understood.
Please wait a moment.

It has been a long time,
Your Excellency Gresco.

Albatro Mill
Julia Asuka.

You were nothing more than
a common Grados soldier.
What happened to you?

Your Excellency, why not open your
heart to the sunlight and the sound
of the wind as well?
And what would come of that?

I beg you, Your Excellency.
Our two peoples must cherish
one another.

By your command,
Terra and Grados can
join hands together.

Julia...
Do you really think I would
give such an order?
I beg of you.

Your Excellency!
I beg of you!

Father!
You must not!

Surely, Father, you don't take
the words of a woman of tainted
blood like this seriously?

Julia!
I shall answer in
my father's place.

The people of Terra... the Terrans...
are a race inferior to us Gradosians
in every respect!

The very idea of joining hands
with them is presumptuous!

No...!
Gradosians and Terrans hold
the same things within.

They are moved by beauty, they
listen to truth, they speak of
love, and they have pride.

And where are these
Terrans you speak of?!

Look around you!
They do whatever we say!

That is because you
make them do so.

Like small children, for no reason,
merely to show off your own strength.

Oh...
You say the most interesting things.

Then show me, through battle, this
hidden power of the Terrans
that you believe in!

If the Terrans win, I will forgive
your slander against me and
spare your life.

But if the Terrans lose,
your life is forfeit!!

I have no desire
for battle!

I shall soon prepare a
field for the decisive battle.

We will settle our long war with
the Resistance once and for all.

What do you say, Father...? Surely
this accords with your heart, which
has no taste for pointless slaughter.

What are you planning,
Le Caine...?

Heh... It's simple. We lure them
out to Paradigm City and crush
them all in one stroke.

What do you mean?
Paradigm City is
allied with us.

Were you not aware, sir?
Of that city's acts of betrayal...

Why is it that the Resistance
holding out on the Gaia Continent
can keep on fighting?

It's because they receive support
from an organization in Asia
called "GEAR."

Their point of contact is the only
corridor connecting the two
continents... namely, Paradigm City!

For the Resistance, that city is
a lifeline they strategically
cannot do without.

If we seize it, they will come
at us in sheer desperation.

Le Caine...
Chase the enemy before your eyes,
and you will misjudge grand strategy.

We of Grados must now
unify all of Terra.

For that purpose, Paradigm
must be allowed to live.

But, Your Excellency,
it's plain that city is secretly
in league with the enemy.

Will you let their kind
run free?!

Le Caine...
It seems you still don't
understand what war is.
Is that so?

To begin with, the reason we
still haven't conquered
the Asia Continent...

Isn't it because your strategy,
Your Excellency, is so timid?!

You go too far,
Le Caine!
My apologies.

Lord Le Caine, even if you win by
making enemies of everyone,
what will be left?

That is what His Excellency
Gresco is telling you.
Keep out of this, outsider!

Your Excellency!
Please heed my counsel!
I will answer you with results!
Very well...

The Cusco gate has stabilized, and
the reinforcements from the homeworld
keep growing larger.

If, as you say, you can take Paradigm
and catch the enemy in a single
sweep, then so be it.

Show me what you can do,
Le Caine!
Yes, sir!

How foolish... To measure people's
worth by the strength of
their arms...
Fuhahahaha!

Julia!
Let the superiority of the Gradosians
be seared into your eyes!

Your Excellency!
The fleet is fully prepared
to sortie!
Well done!

Father has given his permission.
Tomorrow morning, we sortie
for Paradigm City.
Yes, sir!
